name: @gnoverse/x402-gno
description: The gno payment mechanism for the x402 'exact' scheme. Register it on a stock x402 client and it signs payments for the gno chain an offer names.
//repository: npm resolves the package page's relative links against this, and the published page is the repository root README rather than client/README.md.
//exports: The subpath is the ecosystem's own grid — @x402/evm publishes ./exact/client, ./exact/server and ./exact/facilitator, so a buyer that already imports one reaches for the same path here. gno's server half is Go, so ./exact/client is the only cell this package fills.
//engines: The floor a CONSUMER needs, not the one this repo builds with: the emit targets ES2023, which Node 20 covers in full, and neither @gnolang runtime dependency declares a constraint of its own. Working on the package needs newer — tsdown wants Node 22.18+ and CI runs 24.
//scripts: prepublishOnly runs on every publish, from CI or a laptop. `files` ships only client/dist, so publishing an unbuilt tree would put a package on the registry whose single export path does not resolve — and a burned version number can never be reused.
//dependencies: Versions are exact so a signed payment changes only when a dependency is deliberately bumped. @x402/core is a peer: only its types are used, and a mechanism must not pull in a second copy of the client its consumer already has.
